mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflationary pressure (CPIAUCSL > 2.0%) triggers investor concerns about rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.0% in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and robust growth in economic demand (GDPC1) signal accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when the trigger condition occurs (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising demand (RSAFS) and improving labor market conditions (UNRATE decline) signals economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when the trigger condition occurs (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in business supply (INDPRO falling below 95.0) during a recessionary environment signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite INDPRO falling below 95.0 in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A significant improvement in labor market conditions (UNRATE falling below 3.5%) signals stronger employment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive when UNRATE drops below 3.5% (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% during a late-cycle expansion signals peak inflation concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5% in the trigger period (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in economic demand (GDPC1 growth > 2%) and business supply (INDPRO rising > 1.0%) during an expansionary phase signals robust growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive when the trigger condition occurs (p > 0.05 in t-test).
